description_en: A ventilation plate with grid holes
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
width = 100      # 板宽 (mm)
height = 80      # 板高 (mm)
thickness = 3    # 板厚 (mm)
hole_d = 5       # 孔径 (mm)
rows = 6         # 行数
cols = 8         # 列数
spacing = 10     # 孔间距 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, height, thickness)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .rarray(spacing, spacing, cols, rows)
    .hole(hole_d)
)

show_object(result)
